topic: Garp trained an Admiral but lost both grandsons to piracy; what if he kept Luffy
title: Garp Raised Kuzan, Then Failed Luffy (One Piece)
description: Garp trained a future Admiral and still lost both grandsons to the sea. What if he had never left Luffy on the mountain? Full breakdown on the channel: What If Luffy Joined The Marines?
comment: Did Garp fail Luffy by leaving him with Dadan, or did he save him? Pick one.

lines.text: Garp trained an Admiral, and he still lost both his grandsons to pirates.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy ace marine, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here's the detail most people forget. The Admiral he trained was Kuzan, the one who later became Aokiji.

shot.fallback: anime style garp kuzan aokiji training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And in canon, he did not give Luffy the same lessons for long. He left both boys with Dadan on Mount Colubo.

shot.fallback: anime style garp dadan mount colubo, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: I think the answer is that Luffy still gets stronger, because Garp's methods are brutal and Luffy is rubber.

shot.fallback: anime style garp fist of love luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But the Marines can't give him the one thing Chapter 1 already gave him. A dream.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy pirate king dream, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: People say Garp could have forced him. But look at how Ace turned out, a pirate anyway.

shot.fallback: anime style ace pirate whitebeard garp, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So the training works and the Marines don't. That's the twist, a Luffy who is stronger, and still a pirate.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy stronger garp pirate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Because Garp trained an Admiral, and he still lost both his grandsons to pirates.

shot.fallback: anime style garp lost grandsons, dramatic lighting, no text
